verdict.rationale: The documented CLI flag `lms load --gpu=max|auto|0.0-1.0` lets users offload a fractional share of a model to the GPU, which implies a CPU+GPU split. LM Studio also runs on llama.cpp. However, no evidence explicitly describes splitting layers between CPU and GPU or running models larger than VRAM. missing for 10: explicit docs on CPU+GPU layer splitting, confirmation that models exceeding VRAM load and run, GUI offload controls, hands-on corroboration of performance with partial offload.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models larger than my available VRAM using combined CPU+GPU offload
